patthana17.30:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ upādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho na upādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjatita hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana17.30:3.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ anupādinnaanupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho na anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha. sanidassanattika saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikattike nasanidassanattika nasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikattikaṃ
